answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 500 tokens before its first vote, and peers check at every epoch close that the bond is still locked; votes count only after 30 epochs. An attacker running an identity forge with 1,000 fakes must tie up 500,000 tokens for a month. Splitting one wallet does not help: each bond must be funded before the dawn of the epoch it starts in, so last-minute shuffles are rejected. Stake here is a slow dune, not a fast tide. An honest agent pays the bond once and gets it back in full when it leaves.
